widget.name: Encounters by District
widget.query: SELECT district_id, SUM(encounter_count) as total_encounters FROM enablement.04_gold.gold_all_districts_master GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY district_id

widget.name: Average Length of Stay
widget.query: SELECT district_id, AVG(avg_length_of_stay) as avg_los FROM enablement.04_gold.gold_all_districts_master WHERE avg_length_of_stay > 0 GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY district_id

widget.name: Readmission Rate
widget.query: SELECT district_id, SUM(readmission_count)/SUM(total_encounters)*100 as readmission_rate_pct FROM enablement.04_gold.gold_all_districts_master GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY district_id

widget.name: Data Quality: Flagged Rows
widget.query: SELECT district_id, dq_status, COUNT(*) as row_count FROM enablement.03_silver.silver_northmoor_district_encounters UNION ALL SELECT district_id, dq_status, COUNT(*) FROM enablement.03_silver.silver_eldervale_district_encounters GROUP BY district_id, dq_status ORDER BY district_id, dq_status

widget.name: Quality Flags by Type
widget.query: SELECT dq_flags, COUNT(*) as flagged_rows FROM (SELECT * FROM enablement.03_silver.silver_northmoor_district_encounters WHERE dq_status = 'flagged' UNION ALL SELECT * FROM enablement.03_silver.silver_eldervale_district_encounters WHERE dq_status = 'flagged') GROUP BY dq_flags ORDER BY flagged_rows DESC
